We study tidal dissipation in models of rotating giant planets with masses in the range 0.1 − 10 ​ M J 0.1-10M_{\mathrm{J}} throughout their evolution. Our models incorporate a frequency-dependent turbulent effective viscosity acting on equilibrium tides (including its modification by rapid rotation consistent with hydrodynamical simulations) and inertial waves in convection zones, and internal gravity waves in the thin radiative atmospheres.

arxiv-2402-05545.title: Named Entity Recognition for Address Extraction in Speech-to-Text Transcriptions Using Synthetic Data
arxiv-2402-05545.creator: Bibiána Lajčinová, Patrik Valábek, Michal Spišiak
arxiv-2402-05545.description: Abstract This paper introduces an approach for building a Named Entity Recognition (NER) model built upon a Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) architecture, specifically utilizing the SlovakBERT model. This NER model extracts address parts from data acquired from speech-to-text transcriptions. Due to scarcity of real data, a synthetic dataset using GPT API was generated.

arxiv-2409-20316.title: The Dustiest Galactic S Stars: Mid-Infrared Spectra from SOFIA/FORCAST Facilities: SOFIA (FORCAST), Spitzer (IRS), ISO (SWS)

arxiv-2409-20316.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kathleen E. Kraemer, G. C. Sloan, Ramses M. Ramirez. We present spectra of 12 of the reddest, and hence dustiest, S stars in the Milky Way, observed with the FORCAST grisms on SOFIA. S stars are asymptotic giant branch (AGB) stars with C/O ∼ \sim 1, so their molecular and dust chemistries are dominated by neither O nor C, often leading to atypical spectral features from their molecules and dust grains.

arxiv-2501-04867.creator: Serge Tabachnikov
arxiv-2501-04867.description: Abstract 1 Motivation and previous results In the posthumously published “Lectures on Dynamics”, Jacobi claimed that the conjugate locus of a non-umbilic point of a triaxial ellipsoid has exactly four cusps. This is known as the Last Geometric Statement of Jacobi. The conjugate locus of a point is the envelope of the geodesics that emanate from this point.

arxiv-2505-07017.title: Probing quantum phase transition in a staggered Bosonic Kitaev chain via layer-resolved localization-delocalization transition
arxiv-2505-07017.creator: R. Wang, X. Z. Zhang
arxiv-2505-07017.description: Abstract The bosonic statistics, which allow for macroscopic multi-occupancy of single-particle states, pose significant challenges for analyzing quantum phase transitions in interacting bosonic systems, both analytically and numerically. In this work, we systematically investigate the non-Hermitian Bloch core matrix of a Hermitian staggered bosonic Kitaev chain, formulated within the Nambu framework.

arxiv-2509-08948.title: Estimation of deuteron binding energy using Qiskit with renormalization group-based effective interactions
arxiv-2509-08948.creator: Sreelekshmi Pillai, S. Ramanan, V. Balakrishnan, S. Lakshmibala
arxiv-2509-08948.description: Abstract We have obtained the binding energy of the deuteron on a quantum simulator using the variational quantum eigensolver (VQE) for renormalization group (RG)-based low-momentum effective interactions. The binding energy has been calculated in the truncated harmonic oscillator (HO) basis, using the Qiskit-Aer simulator in both noise-free and noisy cases.

pmc-11344049.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), recognized as advanced catalyst carriers due to their adjustable porous, diverse structure and highly exposed active sites, have earned increasing attention for their potential to address the longevity of catalytic centers. In this manuscript, we have devised and synthesized a multifunctional amino-pyridine benzoic acid (APBA) ligand to replace the modulator ligand of the MOF-808 and disperse the palladium catalytic centers atomically on the MOF-APBA.

pmc-12382004.description: BackgroundPeople accessing alcohol and other drug (AOD) treatment experience high rates of loneliness, which is a strong driver of substance use. Groups for Belonging is a 6-session group-based intervention that combines elements of the social identity informed intervention Groups for Health with psychoeducation and strategies to help participants manage loneliness and overcome cognitive barriers to social connection.

pmc-12585560.title: Sociodemographic and lifestyle determinants of blood pressure in adult Nigerians
pmc-12585560.creator: Oluseyi Adegoke, Ifedayo A Odeniyi, Oluwadamilola O Ojo, Obianuju B Ozoh, Ayesha O Akinkugbe, Njideka U Okubadejo
pmc-12585560.description: BackgroundBlood pressure (BP) trends are influenced by genetic, sociodemographic and lifestyle factors, with notable population-specific variations. This study assessed the impact of these determinants on BP in urban Nigerians to identify high-risk subgroups and inform targeted interventions.MethodsWe conducted a cross-sectional study of 5076 adults ages 18–92 y (51.1% female) from Lagos, Nigeria.

pmc-12693809.description: The dynamic behavior of the retrial queueing system following the incorporation of Deep Q-Network Reinforcement Learning in 6G mobile communication services is examined in this study. pmc-12708631.title: Endoscopic ultrasound-guided gastroenterostomy with lumen-apposing metal stent: an animal study comparison of wireless and over-the-wire techniques
pmc-12708631.creator: Laurent Monino, Jean-Michel Gonzalez, Robin Evrard, Eliano Bonaccorsi, Pamela Baldin, Pierre H. Deprez, Marc Barthet, Tom G. Moreels
pmc-12708631.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). EUS-guided gastroenterostomy (EUS-GE) proved efficacy and safety for the management of gastric outlet obstruction (GOO). Nevertheless, lack of standardization and lumen-apposing metal stent (LAMS) misdeployment are limiting its spread. The aim was to compare the wireless endoscopic simplified technique (WEST) and the direct technique over a guided-wire (DTOG) and to evaluate patency and maximal anastomotic tensile strength (MATS) after LAMS-in-LAMS salvage therapy. A prospective animal study was performed comparing DTOG and WEST techniques.

pmc-13051189.title: Facial Overfilled Syndrome: A Narrative Clinical Review
pmc-13051189.creator: Changyang Zhou, Qilei Che, Ruonan Zhao, Haixuan Wang, Qingbiao Wa
pmc-13051189.description: BackgroundFacial Overfilled Syndrome (FOS) is an increasingly prevalent iatrogenic complication resulting from the excessive or inappropriate use of dermal fillers. Clinically significant for causing facial distortion and unnatural dynamics, it is frequently compounded by profound psychological distress and aesthetic perception biases.

pmc-13207232.title: Evaluation of a Novel Autostereoscopic Three-Dimensional System for Binocular Visual Function: A Comparative Validation Study
pmc-13207232.creator: Danjie Han, Yangyi Huang, Ziqing Ding, Jingrong Liu, Jifang Wang, Xingtao Zhou, Wen Wen, Yang Shen
pmc-13207232.description: Background/Objectives: Autostereoscopic three-dimensional (3D) technology represents a promising tool for ophthalmic examinations. However, prior studies have largely focused on stereopsis alone in cooperative adults, leaving comprehensive validation across multiple binocular domains and diverse patient groups unexplored. This study introduces the head-to-head evaluation of a novel integrated, glasses-free autostereoscopic 3D system.

pmc-13486800.description: Rupture of vulnerable carotid atherosclerotic plaques (CAPs) is a major precipitating cause of ischemic stroke. Here, we aimed to identify and validate a noninvasive urinary biomarker of CAP instability and to explore its biological relevance.
